title: Baki Style
author: Alec Q
desc:
Prioritizing calisthenics, aesthetics, functional training with MMA in mind. 

Purposely designed for functional aesthetics to perform like a literal Baki character. Not just the looks, but the abilities too. 

Doesn’t include neck training or forearms. Those are for home 

It’s just a template, feel free to add and subtract as you like. Even if you just do 1 set of each exercise, get used to getting in the groove of them.

ex.note: Planche push up progressions (pseudo planche or tuck) 3x5-8
Focus on technique not just cardio
